decisions.reason: The integrated-board cost and component-selection policy does not change the existing task-local manufacturer ordering assistance or setup procedure.
Selecting JLCPCB Basic components where possible does not alter the existing BOM correctness, part-number, or sensor-board BOM requirements.
The source proposes an integrated-board redesign but does not change the already requested task-local production package for the sensor board.
The cost-conscious integrated-board policy does not address KiCad project portability or footprint-library resolution.
This Requirement is explicitly scoped to the modular main board; the new integrated-board design is a separate architecture and does not retroactively change the modular layout constraints.
The existing mechanical constraints remain scoped to the modular power board, while the source introduces a distinct integrated-board redesign.
The source does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal requirement, and preserving functionality is consistent with retaining it unchanged.
The source does not specify a change to DCDC1 voltage regulation, the 3.3V rail target, or the existing compensation arrangement.

The single-board redesign may replace the enclosure's three-board hardware assumption, but the source does not establish whether the existing enclosure is being redesigned, retained for the modular version, or superseded.
The source does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement behavior; the existing state remains valid for its modular-main-board context.
The Requirement is scoped to the modular sensor board, so eliminating interboard connectors in a separate integrated-board design does not rewrite its existing modular layout state.
The integrated-board sourcing decision does not establish any GPIO reassignment or invalidate the confirmed modular-main-board GPIO mapping.
